temporary: Parity frames named “_parity <context>” are created at x=-4000 and removed by each measurement run (authoring/adapters/figma/counter-parity.plugin.js); experiment clones named “_experiment …” were removed in the same script that created them; none remain.
limitations: openTypeFeatures is read-only in the Plugin API: tabular figures (tnum) are not set on the Value layers; Inter's default figures in Figma are proportional (11 is 12 px wide, 88 is 16 px at md). To switch on by hand (Type settings → Numbers → Tabular) on the typography/indicator text styles or on the six Value layers.
A Figma text layer's auto height is rounded to whole pixels (16 for a 15.4 line height), so the container height is bound to the lineHeight variable instead of hugging the text.
STRETCH constraints on an absolute child round the master's fractional width; the Border uses SCALE constraints, which keep it equal to the box in every instance.

A number variable bound to layer opacity is read as a percentage: the token sync emits opacity variables ×100 (opacity/muted = 70); the former mirror variable counter/border-opacity (VariableID:158:250) was removed on 2026-10-14.
